name: FTG_DOS Policy Possible DDoS Attack (Copy)
description: The FortiGate Application Control module detected traffic related to applications categorized as Proxy or Peer-to-Peer (P2P). These applications are often associated with bypassing security controls or facilitating unauthorized data transfer. This behavior may indicate policy violation, data exfiltration, or attempts to evade detection.
alert_description: The FortiGate Application Control module detected traffic related to applications categorized as Proxy or Peer-to-Peer (P2P). These applications are often associated with bypassing security controls or facilitating unauthorized data transfer. This behavior may indicate policy violation, data exfiltration, or attempts to evade detection.
investigation_query_link:
dataset = fortinet_fortigate_raw
| filter cat = "utm:app-ctrl"
  and (FTNTFGTappcat = "Proxy" or FTNTFGTappcat = "P2P")
| alter
    timestamp = _time,
    src_ip = src,
    dst_ip = dst,
    app_category = FTNTFGTapp,
    application = app,
    action_taken = act,
    log_message = msg,
    request_origin = dhost,
    user = duser,
    message = msg,
    device_name = _reporting_device_name
| fields timestamp, device_name, src_ip, dst_ip, app_category, application, message
